integrity: All-step mathematical claims rely on explicit algebra and analytic convergence proof. Finite executable checks are corroboration, not exhaustive proof. Independent assessment not performed.
limitations: Exact arithmetic; classical four-stage RK4 and one scalar quadratic-energy relaxation; finitely many uncoupled nonzero-frequency planar oscillators with excited squared frequency steps below 12. Does not cover the optimized paired multirate tableaux, nonlinear or nonnormal systems, or floating-point dynamics.
title: Modal selection and a sharp reversal threshold in globally relaxed classical RK4
